methodology.entry: First exchange daily bar whose session timestamp is strictly after signal_at; fill at that session open.
methodology.basket: Equal-weight first 5 configured mechanism proxies from config/investment-seeds.json. Basket membership is frozen at signal creation.
methodology.exits: Close after 1/3/5/10/20 trading sessions from entry session.
methodology.benchmarks: Sector/theme benchmark fixed by mechanism family plus S&P 500 (^GSPC).
methodology.alpha: Basket return minus benchmark return over the identical entry/exit session count.
methodology.live_vs_backfill: LIVE_PREREGISTERED signals are created by scans after this feature exists. RESEARCH_BACKFILL reconstructs older transitions and is excluded from live headline statistics to prevent look-ahead claims.
methodology.sample_gate: Performance quality remains INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE until at least 10 completed observations at a horizon.
